approved_claim_dependencies.claim: For dashboard speed, expensive journey analytics can be calculated into a persisted dataset on a schedule rather than recalculating all historical engagement data on each page load.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Group History becomes available after the Group Type enables history and the Process Group History job has run; its timeline can show group edits and member additions or removals by date.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Archiving a group removes it from normal group-viewer surfaces without deleting it and allows restoration later from the Archived Groups administration page.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: An LMS class can combine content acknowledgements, required video watching, quizzes, file uploads, and facilitator-scored activities, so training design should define both learner actions and staff review responsibilities.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Rock's analytics-enabled tables can be used as a snapshot layer for engagement-style metrics, allowing external reporting tools to query daily counts or trends without repeatedly reconstructing every operational detail.
